mapper.select: SELECT agreement_party_id, agreement_id, party_id, party_profile_id, party_role, acceptance_method, accepted_by_actor_id, accepted_time, evidence_document_id, acceptance_reference, acceptance_ref_slot, acceptance_recorded_by, acceptance_recorded_at FROM t_agreement_party WHERE agreement_id IN (SELECT agreement_id FROM t_agreement WHERE client_id = #{clientId} OR (local_partner_id IN (SELECT source_partner_id FROM t_entity_source_relation WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) AND source_type='PARTNER') AND agreement_id IN (SELECT agreement_id FROM t_agreement_operating_entity WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId})))) ORDER BY agreement_party_id
